subject: Aligning on Hosted runtime deep-dive — SDKs, streaming & tool/function patterns
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@nebulahealth.com>, Elena Rodriguez <elena.rodriguez@nebulahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 16:00:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning on Hosted runtime deep-dive — SDKs, streaming & tool/function patterns

Hi Samir / Elena,

Thanks again for the time today. Per our quick call, Nebula Health asked for a technical deep-dive covering: SDK integration patterns, streaming behavior (server vs. client streaming and reconnects), and tool/function calling best practices for asynchronous workflows. We'd like this to be a hands-on 60 minute session with an architecture overview followed by a short live demo of the SDK streaming usage and a Q&A.

Proposed agenda (attached):
- 10m: introductions & goals
- 20m: runtime architecture & model variants (latency/cost tradeoffs)
- 20m: SDK demo (streaming + function/tool calling example)
- 10m: Q&A / next steps

Are you available for a 60m slot on any of the following?
- Thu 9 Sep, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu 9 Sep, 14:00–15:00 PT
- Fri 10 Sep, 09:00–10:00 PT

If those don't work, send a couple of windows and we will adapt. I copied Marissa (solutions) who will run the demo; Rishi from runtime engineering will join to answer low-level questions.

Attached: agenda-hosted-runtime-deepdive.pdf

Thanks,
Ava

--
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0122

Thanks Ava — this looks great.

Thu 9 Sep at 10:00 PT works best for our engineering team. A couple of notes from our side:
- Can we spend a little extra time on streaming recovery semantics and how Redwood handles partial token delivery if a client reconnects? That's a key concern for our live triage console.
- We'll bring a security engineer (Elena) to validate any enterprise considerations; she'll cover questions on data residency and audit events.

Also, would it be possible to share the runtime architecture diagram ahead of time? It helps our infra folks prep specific questions.

Samir
CTO | Nebula Health
samir@nebulahealth.com

Subject: Re: Aligning on Hosted runtime deep-dive — SDKs, streaming & tool/function patterns

Samir — thanks for the quick reply. I can take the streaming/reconnect portion. A few quick notes so we set expectations:
- Streaming is at-least-once delivery by default for the public hosted path; we have mechanisms for prefix caching and token-level resume keys.
- For client reconnects we can walk through both the client-side SDK approach (resume tokens) and the server-side fallback we use when KV cache misses occur.
- We'll include a short snippet showing function/tool call orchestration (sync vs async) and an example of how callbacks are routed back to a small webhook consumer.

I'll attach an early draft of the runtime diagram (runtime-architecture-draft.vsdx) so your infra team can annotate before the session. Small ask: confirm whether you prefer the meeting in PT or ET timezone for your wider team — we can accommodate both.

Rishi
Principal Runtime Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
